$description: YeRide design tokens — canonical source of truth (DTCG format). Derived files: tokens.cjs/tokens.mjs, tokens.css, tailwind-preset.cjs. Run `npm run check` after editing.

cab-yellow.$description: Brand accent. A fill, not a text color — ink text on top. Fixed by the map.

pullman-brown.$description: Brand primary. Mark strokes, wordmark "Ye", brand-moment text on light grounds. Never as text on dark.

ink.$description: Text on light grounds and on Cab Yellow fills; wordmark "Ride".

paper.$description: Light ground; text color on dark grounds; reversed mark.

brand.$description: Single brand family for everything (docs/brand-system.md). Load 400/600/700/800 only.
